# SunnyLand V3.1 Frame-by-Frame Pose Plans

Redraw anatomy per frame in the established SunnyLand character model. These plans never permit translating, scaling, rotating, recoloring, or reusing a complete unrelated pose.

## walk (6)
0 left heel contact, right arm forward, upright torso. 1 left weight-over-foot pass, arms crossing. 2 right leg swings forward, torso rises one pixel. 3 right heel contact, left arm forward. 4 right weight-over-foot pass. 5 left leg recovery into frame 0.

## run (8)
0 left extended contact, torso leans forward two pixels. 1 compressed left loading pose. 2 right knee drives forward, left arm forward. 3 airborne pass with feet tucked. 4 right extended contact. 5 compressed right loading pose. 6 left knee drives forward. 7 airborne pass returning to frame 0.

## jump_start (3)
0 ready stance, feet planted. 1 knees deeply compressed, arms behind. 2 ankles/torso extended, arms lift, feet separate from floor toward accepted jump frame 0.

## land (3)
0 airborne feet approach floor. 1 deep two-leg impact compression at baseline. 2 torso rises and arms settle toward idle/run contact.

## attack (5)
0 guarded windup, weapon-side arm drawn back. 1 shoulder rotates forward and front foot plants. 2 full horizontal strike with arm/weapon maximum reach, visual contact. 3 torso follows through and rear foot pivots. 4 balanced recovery.

## attack_2 (5)
0 recoil from prior strike. 1 hips turn to opposite diagonal. 2 rising diagonal strike at maximum extension, visual contact. 3 high follow-through with weight shifted. 4 compact recovery toward combo-ready stance.

## attack_3 (6)
0 wide coiled stance. 1 arms/weapon raise. 2 large overhead/downward contact silhouette. 3 deepest follow-through with bent knees. 4 wide recoil. 5 stable recovery.

## dash (4)
0 low preload with forward shoulder. 1 compact launch, rear foot drives. 2 longest forward lean with limbs tucked. 3 rising recovery toward run contact.

## air_dash (4)
0 airborne tuck. 1 arms and front leg extend horizontally. 2 compact horizontal drive. 3 legs open toward fall recovery.

## double_jump (4)
0 airborne recoil with knees bent. 1 feet kick down and arms lift. 2 body fully extends upward. 3 settle into accepted jump silhouette.

## wall_slide (4)
0 both hands/near foot brace toward wall. 1 knees flex while body slips down. 2 opposite foot catches wall, hands adjust. 3 second controlled slip returning to frame 0. Mirroring must keep braces toward wall.

## wall_jump (4)
0 wall brace. 1 legs push away from wall. 2 body travels away with arms spread. 3 upward extension entering jump.

## ground_slam_start (3)
0 airborne open body. 1 arms draw inward and knees tuck. 2 compact vertical preparation with head facing down.

## ground_slam_fall (3)
0 compact down-facing silhouette. 1 arms/legs tighten around vertical center. 2 narrow fastest-fall pose with feet/weapon down.

## ground_slam_impact (5)
0 feet hit floor. 1 deepest compression with arms spread. 2 recoil upward from force. 3 one knee recovers. 4 stable ready stance.

## swim (6)
0 forward reach with left arm. 1 left arm pulls under torso. 2 kick/glide with legs extended. 3 forward reach with right arm. 4 right arm pulls. 5 opposite kick/glide returning to 0.

## swim_idle (4)
0 relaxed float, bent legs. 1 torso rises, left hand sculls. 2 torso lowers, right hand sculls. 3 legs make a small balancing kick.

## grapple (5)
0 eyes/head aim upper-forward. 1 lead arm fully reaches to line. 2 torso pulls under extended arm. 3 legs tuck during travel. 4 release into jump/fall-ready silhouette.

## phase (5)
0 ready silhouette. 1 limbs offset with small transparent gaps. 2 contracted fragmented center silhouette. 3 fragments reform forward. 4 restored forward-ready stance.

## death (8)
0 stagger from damage. 1 knee buckles. 2 torso folds. 3 sideward descent. 4 one hand catches floor. 5 full collapse. 6 prone defeated pose. 7 still defeated hold.

## respawn (6)
0 sparse/reforming low silhouette. 1 head/torso reconnect. 2 kneeling body forms. 3 one foot plants. 4 body rises. 5 ready stance.

## interact (4)
0 neutral ready. 1 small lean toward target. 2 one-hand reach/use pose. 3 arm returns while body recenters.

## ability_acquire (6)
0 look upward. 1 arms gather at chest. 2 arms lift. 3 widest raised/open empowered silhouette. 4 controlled descent. 5 stable proud recovery.
